sources.title: isaki_riona_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive DEV_IS]]'s [[Isaki Riona]].

She wears a [[black jacket]] in which she wears [[off shoulder]] over a [[crop top|cropped]] [[white shirt|white]] [[high collar|high-collared]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]], [[two-tone pants|two-tone]] [[black pants|black]] and [[white pants]] with [[detached pants|detachable legs]] giving the impression of [[knee cutout]]s and [[black shoes|black]] [[high tops]]. She also has a spiked [[earclip]] on one ear and an [[ear chain]] on the other.

h4. Appearance
